product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Push-to-Pop-Out Video Wall TV Mount for Recessed Displays Fits 17 to 42 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Push to Pop Out Video Wall TV Mount for Recessed Displays Fits 17"–42" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Push to Pop Out Video Wall TV Mount for Recessed Displays is engineered for professional AV environments that require flush aesthetics with fast service access. Designed specifically for recessed wall installations, the integrated push to release scissor mechanism allows displays to extend forward for rear access during maintenance, then return securely to a flush mounted position. This mount supports small format commercial displays from 17" to 42" and is intended for indoor, professionally installed video wall applications.Push to release scissor mechanism allows the display to extend forward for rear access, cable routing, and maintenanceSupports 17" to 42" flat panel commercial displays for video wall, control room, and signage applicationsVESA compatible from 50×50 to 200×200 mm for broad display compatibilityMaximum load capacity of 55 lb (25 kg) per screenSupports both landscape and portrait orientations without the need for additional adaptersPurpose built for recessed video wall installations with a compact frame optimized for flush alignmentProfessional installation recommended; mounting surface must support at least 5× the combined weight of display and hardwareDesigned for indoor commercial use only PUSH TO POP OUT SERVICE ACCESSThe integrated push to release scissor mechanism allows the display to extend outward from the recessed wall cavity to provide easy access for cable routing, service, and maintenance. Once service is complete, the display locks back into a closed position, restoring a clean, flush appearance and minimizing handling time. PURPOSE BUILT FOR RECESSED VIDEO WALL INSTALLATIONSThe compact frame and extension geometry are optimized for recessed applications, allowing displays to align with the finished wall surface while still providing forward service access. Designed for indoor use only in controlled commercial environments. SUPPORTS 17" TO 42" COMMERCIAL DISPLAYSCompatible with flat panel commercial displays ranging from 17 inches to 42 inches, making it ideal for control rooms, digital signage walls, corporate interiors, and retail video walls. COMMERCIAL GRADE INSTALLATION & SAFETY REQUIREMENTSDesigned for professional installation. The mounting surface must be structurally capable of supporting at least five times the combined weight of the display and mount hardware, consistent with commercial AV best practices. LANDSCAPE OR PORTRAIT ORIENTATIONSupports both landscape and portrait orientations, providing layout flexibility without the need for additional adapters. PACKAGE CONTENTS• Push to pop out video wall mount assembly• Commercial grade mounting hardware (per component checklist)• Installation manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
